title: Off-chain dispute-resolution jurisdiction
description: Captures the off-chain legal/forum scope under which the contract is adjudicated if disputes escalate beyond the kernel's MAD equilibrium. Per Paper E: settlement on-chain by nature, adjudication off-chain by nature — every signed contract sits inside *some* jurisdiction even if FigaroCore never reads it. Generic across legal traditions: state law (ISO 3166), religious law (Sharia, Halakha), customary law, and ODR systems (Kleros, ICANN-UDRP).

fields.name: applicableLaw
fields.description: Identifier for the body of law that governs the contract. Conventionally an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (e.g., 'US', 'NL', 'JP'), optionally with ISO 3166-2 subdivision (e.g., 'US-CA', 'CA-ON'). 'EU' for European Union law. 'INTL' for international/treaty law. Free-form for non-state legal orders (e.g., 'Sharia', 'ICANN-UDRP', 'Kleros').

fields.name: forum
fields.description: Named adjudication venue. E.g., 'JAMS-arbitration', 'AAA-arbitration', 'ICC-arbitration', 'us-federal-court', 'small-claims-court', 'kleros' for on-chain ODR. Empty means: courts of competent jurisdiction within applicableLaw.

fields.name: language
fields.description: ISO 639-1 / 639-2 language code for adjudication proceedings. E.g., 'en', 'fr', 'zh', 'ar'. Empty means: official language of the forum.
